scope: Focused primary mathematical method references for a conditional common observer domain; no exhaustive originality or model-specific PDE claim.

sources.title: Differential Topology
sources.inspected_text_provenance: Third-party book-text mirror of the primary monograph; publisher page verifies author and edition. Mirror OCR has missing symbols, so formulas were not copied from its damaged lemma statement.
passages_read: Chapter 2 section 1, Lemma 1.3 and Theorem 1.4, printed pages 36–38
Chapter 2 section 1, preceding compact-source topology discussion, printed pages 34–36
Chapter 5 section 1, degree definition and homotopy invariance, printed pages 122–125
supports: Qualitative openness of C^r embeddings for r>=1
Degree as signed regular-fiber count and homotopy invariance
not_imported: No claim that the 2/pi sphere chord constant is a theorem quoted from Hirsch

sources.title: Thickness Formula and C^1-Compactness for C^{1,1} Riemannian Submanifolds
supports: Normal injectivity is global injectivity of the normal exponential map
Distinct focal-distance and global double-critical obstructions in the Riemannian thickness formula
not_imported: The Riemannian thickness formula is not applied to Lorentzian shell geometry
No normal-injectivity lower bound inferred from nondegenerate cut metrics alone
No completeness, minimizing-distance or metric-ball assumptions silently transferred

sources.title: Ordinary Differential Equations and Dynamical Systems
sources.inspected_text_provenance: Authorized author's preliminary version; printed page and theorem locators refer to that PDF.
passages_read: Chapter 2 Lemma 2.14, Corollaries 2.15 and 2.16, printed pages 52–53
supports: Local smooth dependence and higher variational equations under the stated joint C^k hypotheses
Compact-set continuation of locally defined solutions
not_imported: No full perturbed observer flow assumed as a premise of the confinement proof
No shell PDE or physical embedding theorem
Clock-continuous state/parameter-C^2 extension requires its own integral-equation argument if joint C^k is absent

elementary_specializations.proper_duration: S=rho_b*T_q; S is the proper duration, while T_q is a coordinate duration
elementary_specializations.cylinder_normalization: ds^2/rho_b^2+g_round on [0,S] x S^3; F_0(s,Omega)=(-s/rho_b,Omega) in R x R^4
elementary_specializations.embedding_guard: sup ||D(F_e-F_0)||<2/pi in these fixed norms, after full-cylinder existence is proved
elementary_specializations.continuation_guard: a[exp(LS)B_0+phi_L(S)P]<R on a fixed coefficient tube compactly inside the regular ODE domain

limitations: Complete pulled-back shell fields and full section/normal data required
Past data require the complete reflected gauge data
Retained common observer tube was assumed or qualitatively shrunk, without an evaluated radius
Spacelike positivity and global noncrossing need distinct justification
